parameters.description: How many days back, 1 to 90. Default 7.

get.description: Lists news articles, newest first, with tickers, categories, sentiment, importance and a summary when one exists. Filter by ticker, category, publisher, time, text, importance and sentiment; sort by time, rank or score; 50 rows a page.

401.description: The API key is missing, unknown or disabled (invalid_api_key, invalid_token).

402.description: Not enough credits, or a credit budget or call limit was reached (insufficient_credits).

403.description: The package of the key may not call this endpoint, or the endpoint is in preview (package_not_allowed, endpoint_preview).

429.description: A rate or call limit was reached; the Retry-After header says how many seconds to wait.

parameters.name: syms
parameters.description: Ticker symbols, comma-separated, up to 50, any case, for example NVDA,TSLA. Symbols no article carries come back in NotFound.

parameters.name: cats
parameters.description: Category slugs, comma-separated, from the categories endpoint, for example earnings,crypto.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Publisher keys, comma-separated, from the sources endpoint.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only articles published at or after this time (ISO 8601, UTC).

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only articles published at or before this time (ISO 8601, UTC).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to find in the headline or text.

parameters.name: minScore
parameters.description: Only articles that matter at least this much, 0 to 10.

parameters.name: sentiment
parameters.description: Only articles with this reading: Bullish, Bearish, Neutral or Unscored.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by: published (default), rank or score. A minus sign in front sorts high to low, and published is high to low unless you say otherwise.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to return, from 1. Default 1.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 50. Default 50.
